title: Mole Pop
description: Moles are popping out of the lawn! Bop as many as you can in 45 seconds, catch the rare golden mole for big points, and don't bop the sleepy hedgehogs.
instructions: Click or tap a mole to bop it.
Keyboard: number keys 1–9 match the holes (like a phone keypad).
Golden moles are worth 50 points. Hedgehogs cost 20.
Score as much as you can before the timer runs out.
